title: Evidence pocket hunt + daily scratchpad
content:
Quick log — evidence hunt (SOC2) — Ethan M.

Date: 2026-06-22 (working notes)
Status: morning triage; sprinting through vendor artefacts and a few policy TODOs. Mostly manual retrieval + quick notes to self.

TOP PRIORITIES (today)
- Finish VaultCorp vendor control packet: find signed BAA, encryption-at-rest statement, key rotation schedule (target: 2pm).
- Collect RBAC evidence for staging cluster (user lists + IAM role change logs) -> stash in /evidence/staging/rbac-2026-06-22.zip.
- Kick off access-review for 3rd-party service accounts (email owners before EOD).

MICRO-TODOS (quick hits)
- [ ] Download VaultCorp contract (drive: vendor-contracts/VaultCorp/contract-2024.pdf). Confirm clause 4.2 encryption.
- [ ] Snapshot SSO config: screenshots + SAML metadata (okta -> SAML metadata export).
- [ ] Export CloudTrail window: 2026-01-01..2026-06-01 for admins list. Filter: ConsoleLogin, CreatePolicy, DeletePolicy.
- [ ] Ask infra on Slack: "can you export iam:ListAccountAliases for staging account?" (ping @samir)
- [x] Confirmed backup retention policy doc exists (internal: /policies/backup-retention-v2.docx)

VENDOR DEEP-DIVE — VaultCorp (notes)
- Product: key management + secrets store used for tokens. We use their hosted offering in prod and staging.
- Outstanding evidence to fetch: SOC2 report (redacted), BAA, KMS integration diagram, rotation logs (by month).
- Risk note: VaultCorp rotates master keys quarterly but staging shows manual overrides (need log snippet). Put in evidence tag "vault-rotation-2026-q2.txt"
- Questions: do they maintain HSM-backed keys in region us-west-2? If not, note as scope exception.

EVIDENCE MAP (where to put things)
- vault-rotation-2026-q2.txt -> /evidence/vendors/vaultcorp/
- okta-saml-metadata-2026-06-22.xml -> /evidence/identity/
- staging-rbac-export-2026-06-22.csv -> /evidence/staging/
- backup-retention-policy-v2.pdf -> /evidence/policies/
- contract-vaultcorp-BAA-2024-redacted.pdf -> /evidence/vendors/vaultcorp/contract

NOTES / SHORTHAND (things to remember)
- When asking for logs, always request both S3/CloudTrail and provider API events (some rotation events only in provider UI).
- Keep filenames with dates + owner initials to avoid collisions. Eg: vault-rotation-2026-q2-EM.txt
- If doc is sensitive (BAA/SOC2), mark folder restricted and put an access request spreadsheet (owners column).

POLICY TODOS (short)
- Access Review template: tighten the "inactive user" cutoff to 60d (current 90d). -> Draft change + send to policy@. (ETA 2026-06-25)
- Update vendor onboarding checklist to include KMS provider region check and HSM flag. Add item after "Security review".

SLACK / JIRA NOTES
- Slack thread: #sec-evidence "VaultCorp rotation evidence" -> thread pinned by Lina (link above in linked_artifacts).
- Jira: JIRA-SEC-4321 assigned to me — add export artifacts as comments.

QUICK COMMANDS / HINTS
- aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2026-04-01 --end-time 2026-06-30 --profile staging
- okta-cli saml-export --app-id 0oa1xyz --output okta-saml-metadata-2026-06-22.xml

HOLDING QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS
- VaultCorp SOC2 redacted copy: legal has a version but might be NDA-only. Who is legal contact? (ask @lina).
- Staging RBAC export missing service-account mapping (need infra to run export with --include-service-accounts).

END-OF-DAY CHECKPOINT (how I'll mark done)
- 3 vendor docs captured and uploaded to /evidence/vendors/vaultcorp/, names match evidence map.
- RBAC export attached to JIRA-SEC-4321 comment.
- Policy picklist updated in Confluence (link in linked_artifacts).

Random thoughts (scratch)
- Could script vault rotation fetch weekly and push to S3. Low-effort PoC.
- Maybe add an evidence-retention tag in Drive so reviewers can filter sensitive docs quickly.

----
Notes-to-self: keep this doc short-lived. Move completed items to Confluence page "SOC2 evidence ledger" and archive zip into /evidence/archives/2026-q2/
